question: Related Questions Q. استخارہ 1244 views Q. Should we repeat Salah behind an Imam who shaved his beard and lowered his pants, and is one-on-one Aalim course study better than waiting for university? 1999 views Q. I have a question regarding a dream I had. First I need to give you a background of the situation. I married a few months back and with the grace of Allah, my husband and I are trying to have a child. During last week, my mother has had dreams every night about babies and flowers and eating fruits and sweets. She tells me she thinks it is because I may be pregnant. Before I went to sleep one night after my mother told me this, I made dua to Allah to show me a sign in a dream whether I am pregnant or not and then I went to sleep. During that night, I had a dream that a lady doctor has come to my house and she is telling me that she can detect two pulse readings in my body, and she is telling me it is good news (that I am pregnant), in the dream I feel happy, and then I woke up. Please tell me what the meaning of this dream is, and if this relates to the dreams my mother is having almost every night about babies and me being pregnant. JazakAllah Khair. 1636 views Q. I want to know the meaning of two dreams: 1. I saw that arrangements are going on for my marriage. But the nikah has not taken place. I'm getting married to a girl who has revert to Islam from Hinduism. Even the girls parents are present in the marriage and they do not show any objection. 2. I saw another dream ..that two of my teeth have broken on their own. 4866 views Q. کچھ دن پہلے میں نے خواب میں بیت ا للہ دیکھا کہ میں اس کے آس پاس گھوم رہا ہوں ۔ دوسرا خواب دیکھا کہ ایک پر کشش خطاطی میں سورة کافروں لکھی ہوئی تھی۔ براہ کرم، دونوں خواب کی تعبیر بتائیں۔ 1269 views Q. So I would like to know whether it permissible to wear niqab only while going out in the streets or other public places (where there are non muslims strangers) and uncover my face in front of non-mehram relatives (cousins and brothers in law)? I mean is it ok to do it sometimes rather than not doing it at all? 2655 views Q. Please tell me what does this dream mean? My beard is full gray/white (without a single black hair) and full black hair (without a single gray/white hair) on my head. I remember only this much about my dream. 1510 views Q. Aas Salaamoalaikum, One of my relative son died at the age of 27 leaving behind two sisters and his parents. One of the sister was married before his dead while the younger one is marrying now. He came into dream of the younger sister wearing black suit and a red tie and telling her that she is getting married. While at the same time one of the cousin also informed that her daughter also dream of his uncle wearing the black suit and a red tie and also tells her his younger sister is getting married. answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 5843 Country: India Title: I have a question about dreams, I almost daily see Masjid in my dream, someting i will be doing Wazu, sometime i will be giving Azan and sometime will be prearing for Namaz and sometimes wll be doing Imamath, even if the dream is good or bad i see atleast building of masjid in my dream, I am really concerned about, I want to know the meaning of it, or is Allah SWT expecting me to do something, please brief me, About me, i am around 26 years, and I am not very paband on 5 times prayer, will pary 4 times , sometimes 2 times, but i feel a lot that i am not able to pray 5 times, sometimes while sleeping i get tears thinking of me that why I am like this, why cant i pray 5 times namaz. Question: Assalamu alaikum, I have a question about dreams, I almost daily see Masjid in my dream, someting i will be doing Wazu, sometime i will be giving Azan and sometime will be prearing for Namaz and sometimes wll be doing Imamath, even if the dream is good or bad i see atleast building of masjid in my dream, I am really concerned about, I want to know the meaning of it, or is Allah SWT expecting me to do something, please brief me, About me, i am around 26 years, and I am not very paband on 5 times prayer, will pary 4 times , sometimes 2 times, but i feel a lot that i am not able to pray 5 times, sometimes while sleeping i get tears thinking of me that why I am like this, why cant i pray 5 times namaz. Answer ID: 5843 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! Fatwa: 1294/1294=H/1429) Ma-sha-Allah, the dreams are good, their meaning is that you should control the self i.e. keep doing good deeds specially perform all times salah punctually, refrain from sins, particularly do not to miss salah. According to your status and on suitable occasions, you should serve the mosque, though wealth and hands, and clean it. Thus Allah wants to grant you countless bounties in the world and the hereafter. You just need to have guts. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
